segments.text: Allah once revealed Qur'an to clear an innocent man, and expose the Muslim who framed him.
In Madinah, among a noble tribe called the Aws, a coat of armor was stolen.
The thief was one of their own, a Muslim. He hid the armor in a Jewish neighbour's home, and accused him.
His people closed ranks. He is one of us, they said. Take his word over a Jew's.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, was about to rule against the innocent. Then the sky spoke.
We revealed to you the Book in truth, to judge between people by what Allah shows you. So do not defend the deceitful.
segments.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِتَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِمَآ أَرَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَكُن لِّلْخَآئِنِينَ خَصِيمًا

segments.text: And whoever sins, then casts it on someone innocent, has taken a slander, and a clear sin.
segments.arabicText: وَمَن يَكْسِبْ خَطِيٓـَٔةً أَوْ إِثْمًا ثُمَّ يَرْمِ بِهِۦ بَرِيٓـًٔا فَقَدِ ٱحْتَمَلَ بُهْتَـٰنًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا

segments.text: The innocent walked free. The liar, exposed. For Allah, the Most Just, takes no side but the truth.
